verdict.rationale: Anytype gives developers official programmatic surfaces to build against: a localhost API bundled with the desktop app, a gRPC API, a headless CLI for automation, an official MCP server, and an open-source agents toolkit for scripting against Anytype data. However, no evidence shows official language SDKs or client libraries, and no OpenAPI spec was found at the probed doc paths. Missing for 10: named official SDKs or client libraries (e.g. JS/Python/Go) with SDK reference docs, a published API spec for generating clients, and independent or hands-on confirmation of building with them.
